summary: 18 new tests for the 22-case plan in new classes, plus two minimal edits to existing tests; full suite 95/95 against the change

decisions.choice: LinkServiceTest only gains a mock ClickEventRepository constructor argument; PersistenceRestartTest only expects migrations 1,2 instead of 1. No assertion removed or weakened
decisions.rationale: Both edits are forced by the approved design (new constructor dependency, new forward migration); all other existing tests are unchanged and pass

decisions.choice: Two deterministic interleavings, each holding the first operation's transaction (and row lock) open while the second starts
decisions.rationale: A plain concurrent loop would pass by luck; verified by mutation: without the row locks both tests fail

decisions.choice: A @MockitoBean ClickRecorder that throws, through the running context; TC-FR1-03 covers the controller in isolation
decisions.rationale: Proves the 302 survives any recorder failure, end to end and at the unit

decisions.choice: Redirect sent with remote address, User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For, Cookie and Referer probes; asserts the table has only ID, LINK_ID, CLICKED_AT, CLICK_DATE and no probe value is stored
decisions.rationale: Turns the privacy requirement into an executable check

decisions.choice: Builds a real V1-only file database with Flyway target=1 holding a link and a tombstone, then starts the new build on it
decisions.rationale: The upgrade path existing deployments take; V1 checksum validated unchanged

decisions.choice: Covered by the existing LinkCreationTest, LinkLifecycleTest and RedirectLatencyTest, which run unchanged (redirect p99 about 1.1 ms with click recording)
decisions.rationale: The existing suite is the contract for unchanged behaviour
Recorded so the absence of defects is an explicit finding
